decisions.reason: Moving supplied-table integration to the final draft does not change the existing requirement to package the RFQ narrative content into one document.
Photo integration is an independent visual treatment already established from the same message; the table-specific modification adds no change to its state.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the final-draft layout stage, single pass, and full-document coverage; the table-specific decision requires no additional layout update.
The stage and treatment of table integration do not alter the independently specified print-ready PDF delivery format.
The table-integration modification does not change the brand identity or brand assets applicable at this point in the history.
This requirement concerns the separate TPEC proposal, while the source decision concerns the GreenLatinos RFQ.
Changing how supplied tables are integrated does not alter the independently established single revision round.
The source decision does not change the RFQ submission deadline or preferred submission date.
Integrating supplied tables into the final formatted draft does not necessarily change the anticipated page-count constraint.
